content: COMPASS COMPRESSION: BODY LANGUAGE LAYER. April 3, 2026. New research direction identified. The compass currently runs as a 3B decoder (Ministral-3B + 29MB LoRA) generating verbose SHAPE/TONE/SIGNAL/BUDGET text. But the active ingredient is a 3-class classification: OPEN/PAUSE/WITNESS. The state translation that conditions the action model can be templated (3 fixed prompts, one per signal) rather than generated. This means the compass can be distilled from a 3B decoder into an encoder-only classifier. Perplexity research identified candidates: (1) ModernBERT-base — 149M params, Apache 2.0, native MLX implementation with explicit classification support on Apple Silicon, CoreML port available. Trained on 2T tokens with 8k context. Surpasses all prior encoders on GLUE. PRIMARY TARGET. (2) DeBERTa-v3-base — 86M backbone (184M total), MIT license, strongest NLI performance, disentangled attention. SECONDARY for comparison. (3) MiniLM-L12 — 33M params, matches BERT-base at 1/3 size. For edge deployment. (4) DeBERTa-v3-xsmall — 22M backbone (70M total). Floor test. (5) TinyBERT — 14M params. Extreme compression, unclear license. Distillation path: use 3B compass as teacher, label large pool of questions (HumaneBench 800 + expanded corpus), train ModernBERT-base with 3-class head using KL distillation loss. Critical requirement: maintain 100% WITNESS accuracy — a miss means the model speaks when it should be silent. 20x compression (3B → 149M). Inference drops from seconds to <50ms. Runs on phone, Jetson, browser. The governance layer that Mythos needs fits in 300MB.
